title: The Glasshouse of the old quarter
author: Sable Sterling
blurb: Theo Coldharbour, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
